svg.title: Figure 3-1. Software element hierarchy of E-03 and E-01 (WP-W-03 §3.1, §4.1; units from WP-W-05 §2)
svg.desc: The components E-03 safety MCU firmware and E-01 application SoC software of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1 are decomposed into software components. E-03 runs on the panda MCU and consists of 19 elements of the WP-W-03 §3.1 catalogue: the opendbc safety layer U-SAF-CORE, U-SAF-TOY, U-SAF-LAT, U-SAF-LONG, U-SAF-HELP, U-SAF-DEF, U-SAF-IGN and the other brand modes, and the panda firmware U-PND-MAIN, U-PND-COMMS, U-PND-SPI, U-PND-FDCAN, U-PND-HARN, U-PND-FLT, U-PND-PWR, U-PND-HK, U-PND-PLAT, U-PND-BOOT and U-PND-USB, each with its ASIL attribution. Each software component consists of the software units of WP-W-05 §2: 47 implemented units UN-01 to UN-46 and UN-N1, of which UN-36, UN-38, UN-39 and UN-40 exist only in the reference build and UN-44 only in the fault-injection debug build, and 5 planned units UN-N2 to UN-N6 that are not implemented. U-SAF-DEF, U-SAF-IGN, the other modes and U-PND-USB have no unit entry. E-01 runs on the SoC and consists of 10 safety-relevant host elements of §4.1, all QM: host.pandad, host.card, host.controlsd, host.selfdrived, host.plannerd and host.radard, host.modeld, host.dm, host.hmi, host.manager and host.cereal. Nothing is verified on hardware.
